missing_information_behavior: Assess dietary magnesium and current products before considering supplementation; do not infer deficiency from a broad dietary-gap goal.
safety_exclusions: Do not assume magnesium glycinate has proven sleep benefits solely because of its form.
Do not use total compound mass as elemental magnesium amount.
Do not duplicate magnesium across products.
professional_escalation_conditions: Kidney disease, reduced renal function, pregnancy, significant gastrointestinal disease or interacting medicines.
population_and_context: People reporting possible dietary gaps and considering magnesium glycinate; the relevant nutrient is elemental magnesium, not a presumed sleep effect of the glycinate form.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Compare elemental magnesium from supplements with age/life-stage guidance and supplemental upper limits; food magnesium is assessed separately.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Magnesium fact sheet describes dietary sources, elemental magnesium and supplemental upper limit; form-specific sleep claims need separate evidence. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
